user.title: MNML
user.description: Adds MNML's cards, their editors and the MNML theme to Home Assistant.

data.default_theme: Use MNML as the default theme

data_description.default_theme: For everyone who has not picked a theme in their profile, in light and dark mode.

theme_not_loaded.title: Home Assistant does not load the MNML theme
theme_not_loaded.description:
MNML could not make Home Assistant load its theme from `{path}`, so it took the file away again. Home Assistant loads it when `configuration.yaml` reads the `themes` folder like this, after a restart:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```

hand_loaded_bundle.title: MNML Cards are also loaded by hand
hand_loaded_bundle.description: The dashboard resource `{url}` loads MNML Cards a second time, which defines every card twice. Remove it in Settings, Dashboards, the three dots, Resources, or from `lovelace: resources:` in YAML. The repair goes when MNML next starts.

second_theme.title: Two themes are named MNML
second_theme.description: `{file}` also defines a theme named MNML, so one of the two is lost. Remove that file, or remove the standalone MNML Theme from HACS. The repair goes when MNML next starts.
